content:
We currently have dropdowns in MessageData for traces, but it would be nice to also have a "native" dropdown for MessageData in order to hide verbose information in ordinary messages (which is my current use case).

The only visual difference between this and a trace node would be

  1. not inserting [<trace class>] before the dropdown header text. (Note: manually creating a trace message with .anonymous trace class breaks the dropdown entirely, so isn't a workaround.)
  2. (possibly) moving the dropdown triangle (⯈) to before the header text instead of after it

Would this be desirable? And does this sound reasonably feasible since we more or less have dropdowns already, or is there hidden complexity here?

I think this would be useful.
There are quite some warnings/error messages that have a 1-sentence message and then 1+ long paragraphs of explanation what this means or how to deal with this. I think it would be nicer if that's hidden by default, but there is a clearly marked line More Information ⯈ that you can click to get the longer explanation.
